strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Base destroyed
...Then I'll take charge of the Getter Robo.
Please take good care of it, Commander Hazuki. Still...
to think you'd be the successor to General Igor, who died in the last war.
I'm keenly aware that I shouldn't do things I'm not used to.
I'm better suited to tinkering with machines.
No, no, there's room for a scientist like that.
I'm sure Dr. Kabuto would say the same.
Seeing him like this, Commander Hazuki's just a regular old guy.
He can hear you, Fujiwara.
Long time no see, Ryo!
Same to you, Koji. Not since the fight with Dr. Hell, right?
Yeah. After Mazinger went into a museum,
I went over to America to research UFOs.
While we were going back and forth to the lab,
looks like you were keeping busy.
UFOs, huh? I heard you built your own... Is that true?
Yeah, the TFO. But the Pilder's cockpit is still the best.
But... why wasn't the Getter Robo sent to a museum?
I'll tell you.
Getter was kept at the lab as a device for researching Getter Rays.
Somehow that doesn't sit right with me.
No, that's why it couldn't be let outside the lab.
It's the same as Mazinger in that respect.
Of course, we never skipped training, just for times like this.
Sorry to interrupt... I'm Hazuki, Commander of the Far East Branch.
Getter Team, the Gandor unit would truly like your help.
...I'm counting on you.
Likewise. I'm glad to use Getter for the sake of peace again.
I hope you haven't gotten rusty.
The enemy won't accept "we haven't flown it in a while" as an excuse.
Foul-mouthed as ever, Tetsuya. What about you, then?
You left Mazinger sitting in a museum, so you've forgotten how to pilot it...
That wouldn't be the case, would it?
Heh.
...Could it be... they don't get along?
Not exactly. Friendship between men is a complicated thing.
Is that how it is?
Wahahaha! That's how it is. Glad to see nobody's gone soft!
Enemy attack!?
Wha... No way... the Dinosaur Empire!?
What the heck is going on here!?
Dinosaurs or whatever, bring 'em on!
Don't be stupid, Shinobu! Do you even get what this means?
First Dr. Hell comes back, now this... What the hell is going on!
Heh, what's the problem, Ryo? First real fight in ages. Let's go wild!
...All right, let's go, you two!
Chaaaange Getter-1! Switch on!
More of them...!?
One after another... These Mechasaurs are a real pain!
Mechasaurs...? No, I've never seen that type before. A new model?
Ryo! We just analyzed it here...
It resembles a Mechasaur, but there's no past data on it! Stay sharp!
Fuhahaha, don't lump this Hyakki Mecha in with Mechasaurs.
Who are you!?
I am Hidler! One of the Hyakki Empire's Hundred... Marshal Hidler!
The Hyakki... Empire!!
A new enemy force, huh.
So those Dinosaur Empire mechs earlier were merely repurposed...
Tch, quite the rough welcome for Getter's comeback party.
Bring it on!
Damn, today was just reconnaissance...
The day our Hyakki Empire rules this world draws near... Fuhahahaha...
Tch, big talk for someone running off with his tail between his legs!
The Hyakki Empire... Marshal Hidler, huh...
After dinosaurs, now we're up against ogres.
Heh, leave the ogre-slaying to me!
We managed to take care of them.
Unlike mobile suits, their armor is so thick. What a drag.
The Hyakki Empire, was it? That enemy just now.
It seems enemies who were lying low are making moves amid all this chaos.
Either way, all we can do now is keep fighting...
This took far longer than expected. It's a forced march from here.
All hands, keep up maintenance! Be ready to sortie at any time!
Whoa, whoa, that's hardcore.
That's the military for you.
Captain Bright always used to say, "Do it even if it's impossible!"
...I look forward to meeting him.
Hope you're not getting chewed out, Excellen.
